mode_0.meaning: Deterministic validation only (zero LLM validator calls, DeterministicOnlyValidationPolicy)

mode_1.meaning: Single LLM validator (one model STORE/DISCARD decision via SingleLLMValidationPolicy and adapter A)

mode_2.meaning: Dual LLM validators with consensus (two distinct models independent agreement via DualLLMValidationPolicy and Tier3Validator)

notes: MESA_TIER3_MODE env var maps to MesaConfig.tier3_mode (0, 1, 2).
When unset (None or empty), effective mode defaults to 2 if MESA_MODEL_ENABLED=true, and 0 if MESA_MODEL_ENABLED=false.
Mode 0 uses DeterministicOnlyValidationPolicy and bypasses LLM semaphores, circuit breakers, and timeouts.
Mode 2 requires distinct provider/model pairs for A and B.
All 24 validation contract and policy tests in MESA passed on commit 06ebd35a5dc43b75c33351705ddf4afa0a732c61.
